mainEntity.name: Does overspray removal damage the paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Done correctly, no. Overspray sits on top of the clear coat and is lifted off with clay and solvents, then the area is polished. The risk comes from dry scrubbing or using the wrong product, which is why we test a small area first.

Often the contractor’s liability insurance, sometimes your own comprehensive coverage, and sometimes the customer when the amount is small. We provide the estimate and photos; the insurer or contractor decides what they will pay.

mainEntity.name: How soon should it be removed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sooner is easier. Overspray that has cured in the Texas sun for weeks bonds harder and takes more work to remove, which affects the estimate.

mainEntity.name: Can you remove overspray from glass and trim too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Glass, headlights, black trim, rubber seals and wheels each need their own method, and all of them are part of a full overspray removal.
